symptom: Hourly place pages omit a supplied overnight price; supplier 2717 shows six hourly/day-group choices but no night choice.
expected_behavior: If a room supplies a positive overnight price, its page includes לילה with the exact supplied amount; otherwise no night option appears.
environment: VII public production and local .release-v790-candidate, observed 2026-11-12.

steps: Compare with the visible שדה נסתר card on roomsvip.com
reproduction.evidence: VII exposes 250, 250 and 300 for hour durations only; the legacy card also exposes לילה 550.

observations.observation: The current public and bundled normalized entries for supplier 2717 contain no לילה rate.
The shared place-detail UI already maps every normalized room rate into a selectable control.
Importer and runtime client duplicated a narrow guessed mapping that only inspects basePrices paired fields.

hypotheses.mechanism: The supplier overnight value is outside the two guessed paired basePrices aliases or is scalar, so normalization drops it before rendering.
hypotheses.prediction: Normalized JSON lacks night although the source consumer displays it, while the UI would render it if present.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare normalized supplier 2717, the legacy visible card and the place-detail all-rates renderer.
hypotheses.result: Matched: normalized data lacks night, legacy card shows 550, and UI iterates all normalized rates.

hypotheses.mechanism: CSS or a fixed UI limit hides the seventh/eighth rate control.
hypotheses.prediction: The normalized model contains a night rate that is absent from the DOM.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect public catalog JSON and live DOM for supplier 2717.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: neither normalized JSON nor DOM contains a night rate.

fix.change: One shared bounded rate normalizer now serves the build-time importer and runtime client, reads exact scalar or paired overnight values from basePrices or the room projection, and never creates a night option from missing or invalid data.
fix.evidence: app/lib/sergey-hourly-rates.ts; 18 scoped tests passed; TypeScript and ESLint passed; desktop and 390px visual layout evidence contains eight controls with no overlap.

regression_checks: Scalar room-level night price reaches the supplier catalog and detail model.
Separate weekday and weekend night prices remain distinct.
Missing, zero, negative, malformed and unrelated fields do not create a night price.
Hourly detail renders all rates without a duration cap.
Desktop and 390px selectors fit eight controls without overlap.
remaining_unknowns: Exact live supplier alias must be recorded during the next authenticated refresh. Public production still uses the old normalized catalog and therefore remains unchanged.
authorization_boundary: Local diagnosis and repair; no public deploy or catalog activation.
